value.rationale: The exact if-and-only-if diagram identifies structurally delicate oscillatory regimes: a unique size triple for least period six, a thin infinite period-four family and the disappearance of twelve-cycles when the smallest shore reaches four. The sharp uniform entry bound is nontrivial for arbitrarily large graphs. These are natural global invariants, not small fixed-size recomputations.
